official_protocol.scope: anonymous symbol-level open-interest cap; never a personal maximum
official_protocol.sentinel: Exact string -1 means no contract cap; string 0 is a known zero. Missing, malformed or failed response is neither.

implemented: Immutable explicit one-way signed position and bid/ask pending-notional inputs; hedge gross-risk inputs. No inferred zero for absent pending data.

Decimal notionals and opening losses; Rational initial margin division. Pending one-way reserved exposure is the larger of two directions; added margin is nonnegative incremental reservation divided by leverage. It is not an actual post-fill position.
One-way opening loss applies only beyond the existing opposite position. Hedge opening never receives opposite-position credit.

Exact BigInt binary search over minimum+k*step; separate normalized-margin, personal leverage cap, contract opening cap, maxQty and minimum-notional constraints. No future released-margin or fee/rebate credit.
Independent buy/sell maxima and quote display conversion; integer percentages 0..100 floor independently, never round a tiny allocation up to minimum.
Public cap service helper and strict mapper retain symbol/leverage/time, exact sentinel and safe failures. No provider/widget calls the helper in this increment.
unfinished_required_integration: Signed coherent account, positions, pending orders and all required risk brackets; margin normalization for cross/isolated and multi-asset collateral, including negative equity policy.

Authoritative pending notionals and order-type price assumptions. Official V3 account/position examples do not document the frontend bidNotional/askNotional fields; do not read absent fields as zero or copy an undocumented market buffer.
Live price/event invalidation and fresh directional capacity recheck before confirmation and after wallet prompts.
Main slider UI, initial zero with blank inputs, two-sided quantity/notional/cost/liquidation previews, preservation and frozen same-side confirmation.

Full post-trade liquidation estimator, full strategy management, Chase recovery, Portfolio across products and Swap remain outstanding. User-deferred historical statistics/Summary/TWAP remain deferred.
boundaries: This is staged domain/transport work, not a completed main-order slider or actual personal maximum in the app.

Caller must supply normalized available margin and actual account-specific risk limits. A supplied negative budget is clamped to zero in the kernel; this is not evidence for Aster negative-equity acceptance.
Fees, execution slippage, actual fills and liquidation are not outputs of this cost kernel. Order-type assumed and loss prices and quote conversion are separate required inputs.
The public website uses JavaScript Number and rounded inverse leverage; this kernel intentionally preserves exact ratios. Last-place native/website parity is not proven.
Current quick-order reference sizing and main-order submission are unchanged. No new wallet, automatic signature, private request, funds action, device tool, APK install or address-bearing RPC.
next_action: Assemble validated signed capacity inputs through repository/provider; resolve required pending-notional and order-price semantics, then connect dual-side slider/previews and confirmation checks without claiming incomplete cases as full capacity.
